messages.content: Perform Gaussian integral of the function exp(-x^2) from -2 to 2. Also calculate the definite integral from 0 to 3.1416 of sin(x).

function.name: math_gaussian_integral
function.description: Perform Gaussian integration over the range of the function. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
The function to integrate, given in terms of x.

lower_limit.description: The lower limit of the integral. This is a float type value.

upper_limit.description: The upper limit of the integral. This is a float type value.

function.name: math_definite_integral
function.description: Calculate the definite integral of a function within specified bounds. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
The function to integrate, given in terms of x.

lower_limit.description: The lower limit of the integral. This is a float type value.

upper_limit.description: The upper limit of the integral. This is a float type value.
